purpose: predeclared NR-only quality screening before replacement-waveform inspection and fitting
candidate_order: nondeprecated replacements ranked using metadata alone; freeze candidate IDs/order before waveform H5 download; next prespecified candidate only after earlier candidate fails fixed gates
primary: highest available numerical resolution, N3; never choose extraction order based on agreement with LAL
required_data: highest two available resolutions, N2 and N3 each; exact same-record same-resolution metadata and sidecars verified by inventory MD5 and size

frequency_band.minimum: 0.95 * independent f_ring_33 from highest N3 matching remnant metadata

metric: geometric Fourier amplitude relative L2; denominator is highest-resolution N3; native highest-N3 frequency bins over overlap of all compared spectra; linear amplitude interpolation, no extrapolation

definitions.preprocessing: each fixed preprocessing variant versus highest-resolution N3 baseline
definitions.eccentricity: finite scalar or numeric upper bound; absent/unparseable does not pass
definitions.metadata_units: waveform reference-mass normalization; matching resolution metadata code-unit masses/times converted by total reference mass; dimensionless spins unchanged

fit_policy.holdout_policy: q3/q6 replacements and their alternate resolutions/orders never enter training; inspected historical pilot cases excluded
fit_policy.if_insufficient_quality: do not fit; report failed gates and remaining dataset gaps
fit_policy.LAL_policy: no LAL calls before new calibration and split are frozen; any subsequent call is validation only

limits: NR-only quality screening inspects holdout NR for numerical quality but never uses holdout fit residuals to select data or coefficients
replacement simulations can share a physical family with old runs; they are new to this fit, not necessarily independent of earlier NR generation
amplitude-only selected-band gates do not prove complete complex-waveform accuracy
